title: Tech Note: 4D and Web Pagination
author: Charles “Charlie” Vass, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The core pagination UX principles remain timeless and still apply to any web application built with 4D today. However, the concrete implementation techniques — 4D Tags-based HTML generation and the classic 4D Web Server request model — have been superseded for new development by REST/ORDA-based APIs consumed by modern JavaScript front-ends (e.g., React, Vue) that handle pagination client-side against paged entity selections, making server-side 4D Tag templating far less common for new projects.
related_updates: REST APIs built on ORDA entity selections (4D v16 R5+) with client-side pagination in modern JS frameworks, replacing 4D Tags-based server rendering for new web apps
